summary: A session's worktree is the directory the host reports per call; Concord sets no effective target, and session preparation records no placement. Retained metadata supports verification and inspection without ownership writers. Verify leases exclude concurrent commands, continuity re-pins held leases, and retryable transient exclusion is resource_busy with retry_same_request.
title: A session's worktree is its actual directory, and Concord stores no session binding
